}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "WZR-HP-G302HV2", "21514W302HV21A1 Rev: A0-2", "03000611122010A" are silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. This device appears to be manufactured by [[Cameo]] (2151…).
The default SSID appears to be the wireless interface MAC address (no delimiters, upper case hex digits). The device probably uses [[Atheros]] AR9287 for the Wi-Fi chip.
*[http://wiki.openwrt.org/toh/buffalo/wzr-hp-g300nh2 ''Buffalo WZR-HP-G300NH2'' on '''OpenWrt''' wiki] (ToH) *Revision A1A0 and WZR-HP-G302H A1A0 (Japanese variant) WZR-HP-G302H is Japanese market name for WZR-HP-G300NH2, and seems to have slightly different Wi-Fi chip, [[Atheros]] AR9283-AL1A. "WZR-HP-G302HV2" and "21514W302HV21A2 Rev:A2" is silkscreened on the board. *Revision B0A0 (marketed as N300 HighPower Gigabit) [[Buffalo WZR-300HP|WZR-300HP]] This board, marked "WZR-HP-G302HV2 Rev:A3", is nearly identical to the other revisions, and the same image appears to flash successfully.
